title: Adult blood pressure categories

passage: Following ACC and AHA guidelines, CDC describes adult blood pressure as normal when below 120/80 mm Hg and elevated when systolic is 120-129 mm Hg with diastolic under 80 mm Hg. title: Severely high blood pressure (above 180/120 mm Hg)
case_context: 34-year-old man; Systolic BP 186 mmHg; Diastolic BP 112 mmHg; notes: Headache since morning, one high reading at triage.
passage: NHLBI treats a reading above 180/120 mm Hg as too high and in need of medical attention, especially with symptoms, because pressure at this level can damage organs. The scan can also reveal damaged or dead heart muscle, possibly from an earlier heart attack.

case_context: 44-year-old woman; notes: Sharp chest pain when pressing on the chest wall.
